The '''tangler tree''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Considered to be a docile species, the tangler tree had tentacle-like [[Vine/Legends|vines]] and branches that intermingled with other [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], a tangler tree was mutated by the renegade [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Savor Kibbs]]. Sitting in the middle of an area that came to be known as the [[dark grove]], the mutated tangler tree was more hostile than other members of its species and had thick, sharp thorns on its vines. Members of the [[Naboo Underground]] were attacked by the tree during their mission to deal with Kibbs and his [[Savor Kibbs' followers|followers]].<ref name="Invasion" />
